overloads.semanticRole: The SORT LIST command sorts the list whose reference number is passed in list .

constraints: The order symbol is counterintuitive: > sorts ascending, < sorts descending; if omitted, the sort is ascending.
Sorts all levels of the list: first the top-level items, then the items of each sublist, recursively through all levels.
Does not change the current list item or the current expanded/collapsed state, but the current item's position may change as a result of the sort.
